A [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] '''individual''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] active at one point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and approximately [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. They once performed Jedi [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] while three [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] were [[Telekinesis/Legends|floating]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] around them.

==Biography==
A [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]<ref name="TNR" /> was a [[Jedi/Legends|member]] of<ref name="TNR" /><ref name="Art" /> the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|disbanded]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="TNR" /><ref name="Art" /> who was active<ref name="TNR" /> at some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and approximately [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="TCGDate">''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'' expansion of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]] takes place at some point during [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]{{'s}} events, which are set between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and approximately [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:SWG timeline|here]].</ref> At one point, they sat cross-[[Limb/Legends|legged]]<ref name="TNR" /> on the floor<ref name="Art" /> of a room, having assumed a [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] pose and performing a Jedi meditation, during which three [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]&mdash;one pyramidal and two twelve-sided&mdash;and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]<ref name="TNR" />&mdash;the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] of which shared similarities with [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|that]] wielded by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and later his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]]<ref name="CVD2016">[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary (2016)|''Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary'', 2016 edition]]</ref>&mdash;[[Telekinesis/Legends|floated]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] around the Jedi.<ref name="TNR" />

==Personality and traits==
The Togruta had [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin with white markings around their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and their [[Montral/Legends|montrals]] and [[Lekku/Legends|head-tails]] were white with gray stripes.<ref name="TNR" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Jedi had the ability to [[Force-sensitive/Legends|use]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to perform telekinesis.<ref name="TNR" />

==Equipment==
The Togruta Jedi wore a light-brown low-cut [[Clothing/Legends|top]], light-brown pants, a brown [[Robe/Legends|robe]], and light-brown wrappings on their hands and lower arms. On their montrals and head-tails, they also wore a brown [[Leather/Legends|leather]] headdress with a number of different [[Gold/Legends|gold]]-colored [[Metal/Legends|metal]] ornaments.<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Togruta Jedi was depicted on a card in<ref name="TNR" /> the [[December 15]], [[2009]]<ref name="TNRdate">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68561&month=122009|text=The ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™ Trading Card Game: The Nightsister's Revenge Releases Today!}}</ref> ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'' expansion of [[Sony|Sony Online Entertaiment]]'s [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]]. They were illustrated by [[John Stanko]].<ref name="TNR" />
